interface.tx: ActiveLaneSnapshot::new(externally_authenticated GameScope,caller qualified LaneSpec vec sorted once); GameTx::new(snapshot,GameLimits); offer(original UniqueBuffer,window,Mode::Game or Normal,predicted_lane_wire_bytes,optional BlockIdExt,MonoNs); drain_ready(now,max<=32,callback SendView)->DispatchOutcome; rotate(externally qualified snapshot); stop idempotent.

interface.normal: Never generates Game LogicalPacketId/envelope, exactly one lane per offered business frame, round-robin including newly qualified B, old A draining frames keep original MSS and owner.

interface.no_hol: One full/backpressured lane increments lane_copy_drop; other qualified lanes dispatch already-ready independent copies, no 4-lane barrier or waiting for all joins.
interface.ownership: GameTx Stop returns owner-held pending references and original slab; external callback-created loan remains owned outside. GameRx completed shard bundle remains owned outside after Stop until final drop, no false quiescence.
interface.frozen_interfaces: No new root dependency, no ABI/wire change, no stable 012 queue/wake API changed.
